items.title: FRT- A Dividend King in the Retail REIT Subsector
items.summary: Federal Realty Investment Trust (FRT) is a retail REIT that owns 103 properties spanning 28.8 million commercial square feet, with roughly 3,700 tenants. The portfolio is primarily retail-based, while the remainder includes roughly 2,500 residential units and office properties, observes Ben Reynolds, editor of Sure Dividend High Yield Newsletter.
